title: AI proposes, deterministic disposes
context: Every AI path (planner narrator, FX briefing, FX hedge advisor, credit signals) must be safe for a regulated setting.
decision: The LLM only writes prose, ranks candidates, and picks from whitelists that deterministic code produced. It NEVER invents monetary amounts, counterparties, or rate predictions. Every AI path has a deterministic fallback that runs on no-key, timeout, or validation failure. LLM output is JSON-parsed and every field validated; invalid picks are silently discarded.
hard_rules: Never predict, forecast, or comment on where FX rates will move.
Never invent a counterparty — id must be in the input whitelist.
Never invent an amount — must be present in the input.
Use display strings ('€10m', '$21m') verbatim; never full digit strings.
Booking is never done by AI — the treasurer always clicks Initiate, which runs the six checks.
consequences: planner_narrator._fallback runs when Groq key is missing or LLM response invalid
fx_narrator._deterministic_briefing produces the same-shape output without the LLM
fx_narrator.advise_on_hedge builds facts deterministically, then optionally has the LLM rewrite the same bullets — bullet count must match or fallback wins
Every AI panel carries a user-visible caveat: 'Governance narration, not a market view.' / 'AI narrates policy gaps; it does not predict rates.'
